role: prospective Track A only, exploratory, outside H1-H3

cohort.unit: one frozen active-moiety set per cutoff, FIX2c Track A identity rules
cohort.eligibility: dated final original NDA with dated TYPE 1 eligibility and no first final original ANDA as of the cutoff
cohort.outcome: first dated final FDA original ANDA approval in (cutoff, cutoff + 24 calendar months]
cohort.training_label_rule: require independently verified S0 coverage and resolved linkage through the full window for either class; no-event is 0 only with such coverage; unresolved is omitted jointly
cohort.roster_order: ascending SHA-256 of compact UTF-8 JSON [20261127, drug_key, cutoff_iso] with unescaped Unicode, then cutoff, then drug key
cohort.roster_fill: take first 256 eligible resolved ordered rows; if fewer, cycle from the start to fill 256 slots; check both classes among the selected rows before running
cohort.track_a_roster: all eligible frozen S0 24-month drug keys in both arms, including predictable missing evidence

prompt.contract: L1e (C2/K24), same renderer, dated source allowlist, field order, missingness and text bytes in both C9 arms
prompt.pin: Reviewed C2 config and renderer revision plus SHA-256 in the submitted preregistration; no fallback contract
prompt.evidence: C2's label-free as-of M3 evidence projection with cutoff-eligible record dates and demonstrated source availability; preserve provenance in the manifest
prompt.oversize: fail pair; no arm-specific truncation or row removal

checkpoint.base_weights: frozen non-quantized bf16, same model and tokenizer bytes in both arms

training.calendar: January 2027 before the Track A freeze

adapter.initialization: default PEFT LoRA A Kaiming uniform, B zero; clone identical initial adapter bytes

grpo.reward: -(p_entry - y)^2 for schema-valid completions, including abstention
grpo.advantage: center within prompt group and divide by population reward standard deviation + 0.0001
grpo.ratio: per generated token, against rollout policy log probabilities fixed for both updates
grpo.reference: same frozen base, initial zero-effect adapter
grpo.loss: negative mean of per-completion mean clipped surrogate less tokenwise DeepSeekMath KL; mask prompt and padding

sft.target: canonical JSON with p_entry=float(y), PREDICT_ENTRY if y=1 or PREDICT_NO_ENTRY if y=0, missing_evidence=[]; then assistant EOS
sft.loss: mean of per-target mean teacher-forced token negative log-likelihood; mask prompt and padding
sft.data_access: same rendered prompts, mature labels and batch order as GRPO; no extra targets, examples or calibration

training.selection: use each arm's finite adapter immediately after update 64, with no intermediate selection, extra seeds or early stopping

prediction.dtype: bfloat16 base with frozen float32 adapter
prediction.stop: tokenizer assistant EOS or token cap; parse the complete decoded continuation
prediction.freeze: hash and tag S0, C2 contract, runtime, row and prompt manifests, both adapters and both full label-free prediction files; record Git tag and hashes on OSF by the independently scheduled core freeze, before deadline and before any post-S0 outcome fetch

evaluation.difference: GRPO minus SFT; lower Brier and higher recall favor GRPO
evaluation.brier: mean squared probability error using raw p_entry including schema-valid abstentions
evaluation.queue: descending valid p_entry including abstentions; floor(N/5) on the full S0 roster; uniform expected allocation of boundary ties
evaluation.malformed: retain row as evaluator referral, use fallback Brier probability and rank below every valid score; report count and rate by arm
evaluation.missing_completion: require captured decoded text for each frozen row in both arms; a recorded empty completion is malformed, a missing completion fails the pair
evaluation.unresolved_outcome: hold scoring until identical mature binary labels cover the full paired roster; never count unknown as zero

bootstrap.unit: whole drug, 2000 common paired draws with replacement; rebuild queues in every draw
bootstrap.interval: two-sided empirical 95% percentile interval from finite draws using the metrics.py order statistics; report undefined draw counts and omit an interval with no finite draws

evaluation.interpretation: exploratory paired effects conditional on one fitted seed and the frozen cohort; no hypothesis gate or efficacy conclusion

budget.gpu_sku: same 24 GiB NVIDIA A10 for both arms, sequential
budget.storage: ephemeral only; include storage, transfer, fees, taxes and cleanup, split shared charges evenly
budget.admission: live itemized January quote and recorded owner approval before pod creation; include setup, hosted smoke, training, freezing predictions, billing increments, artifact pull and deletion; stop before either cap would be exceeded

conditions: unequal data access or unpinned C2 prompt
empty, underfilled or single-class training roster
unverifiable source coverage or input hashes at freeze
missing or incomplete SFT or GRPO arm
missing, altered or unpaired forecast artifacts
missed external timestamp or prior post-S0 outcome fetch
no verified mature outcome coverage for final scoring
pair_failure.core_track_a: freeze core arms on schedule independently of C9
